title: An Omnipotent King Surrenders For Love

cuts.voiceover_text: Facing imminent death, the terrifying Chimera Ant King surrenders every desire for world conquest. Meruem admits total defeat to his enemy for one reason: he only wants to spend his final moments with the human girl Komugi.
Palm stands paralyzed in complete disbelief. She expects violence from a monster, but instead witnesses an omnipotent king humbling himself for love.
Knowing the fatal poison is taking his life, Meruem refuses to use force or torture. His genuine request leaves Palm utterly overwhelmed and brought to tears.
